name: coordinator-amortized-flush
body: The coordinator amortizes DB work across the session: one open/parse serves N mutations, and the derived-projection flush is batched into a single re-ingest (or a bounded number) at `apg session end` rather than one ingest per mutation. Acceptance: an N-mutation session performs materially fewer DB opens/ingests than the current per-mutation path, and the final DB matches a fresh re-ingest of the durable layers tree.
